SELECT o.o_title AS o_title, o.o_tag AS o_tag, o.o_content AS o_content, o.o_regdate AS o_regdate, NULL AS user_content, NULL AS user_regdate FROM tbl_offers o WHERE o.ono = #{ono}

SELECT NULL AS o_title, NULL AS o_tag, NULL AS o_content, NULL AS o_regdate, s.o_content AS user_content, s.o_regdate AS user_regdate, r.rno AS rno FROM tbl_submissions s LEFT JOIN tbl_room r ON r.ono = s.ono AND r.company = #{company} AND r.emp = #{uno} WHERE s.ono = #{ono} AND s.uno = #{uno}

SELECT o.ono AS ono, o.uno AS uno, c.corpnm AS corpName, o.o_tag AS category, o.o_title AS title, o.o_activedays AS o_activedays, c.enpempecnt AS enpEmpeCnt, c.enpbsadr AS enpBsadr, c.enprprfnm AS enpRprfnm FROM tbl_offers o JOIN tbl_cinfo c ON o.uno = c.uno LEFT JOIN tbl_uprofile u ON o.uno = u.uno WHERE o.o_activedays >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) ORDER BY o.ono DESC
